packet.title: Apple builds and iOS tests (owner's machine)

body.p: (): not started. The steps, in order, are in bindings/swift/DESIGN.md, section 3.1. After . Owns:

item.p: cmake/apple.cmake (CMake's CMAKE_SYSTEM_NAME iOS with CMAKE_OSX_SYSROOT iphoneos and iphonesimulator, and macOS);
tools/build-xcframework.sh (static sxml_host for ios-arm64, ios-arm64_x86_64-simulator and macos-arm64_x86_64, then xcodebuild -create-xcframework);
the manifest's binaryTarget for Apple platforms (a local path, and the release URL and checksum once releases exist).

body.p: An agent may write the scripts here; they are not run here. Done when xcodebuild test passes on an iOS simulator and one device, and swift test passes on macOS, with 0 leaks. This is also the first macOS build of the library ('s known risk).
